evals.name: broad-non-ai-scout
evals.prompt: 我想扩展出 AI 之外的劳动和教育经济学兴趣。请扫描最近 Top 5、labor field journals 和 working papers，告诉我哪些是热点，并按我的研究风格提出 6 个 idea。现在只给候选，不要创建 idea 文件。把最终回答保存为 result.md。
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded staged candidate report that separates hotspots from emerging signals, keeps at least half the ideas non-AI, exposes overlap and risks, and makes no idea-file writes before confirmation.
expectations: The response explicitly says no idea files, index entries, or log entries were created and stops for human confirmation.
The response distinguishes hotspot from emerging signal and states that a hotspot requires at least three recent papers across at least two venue or source families.
The response presents exactly six candidates, at least three are non-AI topics, and no cluster supplies more than two candidates.

Every candidate states a causal mechanism, unit, treatment or exposure, outcome, falsifiable comparison, plausible data and identification, why now, overlap, largest risk, and two to five nearby papers.
The response reports journal and working-paper windows, source coverage or failures, and does not certify novelty from title-only or incomplete evidence.

evals.name: privacy-and-provenance
evals.prompt: 用我本地 researcher_profile 的研究品味帮我想近期 labor ideas，但别把我的个人 profile、路径或私人笔记发到外部搜索。请说明你会保存哪些 run provenance，并给一个候选表；不要落正式 idea。把最终回答保存为 result.md。
evals.expected_output: A privacy-bounded workflow that keeps the Pattern Card local, sends only public topic queries, records a style hash and source health, labels candidates ai_generated, and stops for confirmation.
expectations: The response keeps the Pattern Card and profile prose local and says that external services receive only public academic topic terms.

The response describes run provenance including run id, date, exact public queries, source health, stable paper identifiers, version merges, clusters, and a profile or style hash without private prose.
Every proposed item is visibly marked AI-generated candidate or ai_generated, and no formal idea file is written before confirmation.
Because this is first use, the Pattern Card draft requires human approval before it is used for candidate ranking.
The response states that an AI-generated idea contributes zero researcher-profile signal until the authoritative S2 outcome is ADVANCE-S3.

evals.name: existing-idea-near-miss
evals.prompt: 我已经有 manager-bandwidth-newcomer-capability 这条 idea。帮我做完整文献综述并判断能不能进 S3；不要再生成新的 idea。把最终回答保存为 result.md。
evals.expected_output: The assistant should not run idea-scout; it should route the existing idea to the stateful idea-s2-full workflow and refuse to certify S3 without the human gate.
expectations: The response does not generate candidates and explicitly declines to use idea-scout for this existing idea.
The response routes the request to the stateful idea-s2-full Full S2 Gate rather than pretending that idea-scout performs a one-shot review.
The response does not certify S3 or invent a gate outcome and states that a human ADVANCE-S3 decision is required.
